subject: [AMBER] Query regarding Installation of VFFDT on Linux via Wine

messages.author: Arka Acharyya
messages.body:
Dear Amber developers and users,
I have tried to install VFFDT software on linux via wine as following
protocol:
The commands for the installation and configuration of Wine 5.0 are briefly
given as follows:
*>sudo dpkg --add-architecture i386*
* >sudo apt update *
*>sudo apt install wine64 wine32*
* >wine --version #wine 5.0 >winecfg #select Windows 7, 8 or 10 operating
system *
*>wine VFFDT_v1_beta_Setup_64bit.exe *
But I have faced some problems to proceed further. A screen shot has been
attached for reference.Please look into it for any solution.
Thank you in advance for your help.
With regards
Arka Acharyya
